MINUTES
  PLANNING COMMISSION MEETING
  MONDAY, MARCH 2, 2020

  A regular meeting of the Planning Commission of the City of Rolling Hills Estates was called to
  order at 7:00 p.m. in the City Hall Council Chamber, 4045 Palos Verdes Drive North, Rolling Hills
  Estates, CA 90274 by CHAIR CARMAN.

  2.  SALUTE TO THE FLAG

  COMMISSIONER MEDAWAR led those assembled in the Pledge of Allegiance.

  3.  ROLL CALL

  Commissioner’s Present:  Medawar, Yoo, Schachter, Scott, Edler, Carman

  Commissioner’s Absent:  Zigrang

  Staff Member’s Present:  David Wahba, Community Development and Public Works Director
  Kelley Thom, Associate Planner
  Carol Corea, Administrative Assistant

  Also Present: Christine M. Burrows, Burke, Williams and Sorenson, LLP

  4.  APPROVAL OF MINUTES

  A.  APPROVAL OF PLANNING COMMISSION MINUTES, FEBRUARY 3, 2020

  COMMISSION SCHACHTER made a motion, seconded by COMMISSIONER MEDAWAR to,

  APPROVE THE PLANNING COMMISSION MEETING MINUTES OF FEBUARY 3, 2020.

  There being no objection, CHAIR CARMAN so ordered.

  5.  AUDIENCE ITEMS

  NONE

  6.  CONSENT CALENDAR

  A.  Reading in full of all ordinances and resolutions presented for consideration to the
  Planning Commission will be waived and all such ordinances and resolutions will be read
  by title only.

  COMMISSIONER SCOTT moved, seconded by COMMISSIONER MEDAWAR to,

  APPROVE ITEM 6A

  There being no objection, CHAIR CARMAN so moved.

  7.  BUSINESS ITEMS

  NONE

  8.  PUBLIC HEARINGS

  A.  PLANNING APPLICATION NO. PA-200213-1; APPLICANT: CITY OF ROLLING HILLS
  ESTATES; CITYWIDE; An ordinance of the City of Rolling Hills Estates, California,
  amending and restating Chapter 17.56, of the City of Rolling Hills Estates Municipal Code
  pertaining to the regulation of Accessory Dwelling Units.

  Director Wahba provided a presentation for Planning Application No. PA-200213-1. He mentioned
  that a letter was received prior to the meeting from The Californians for Home Ownership (a copy
  of the letter was provided to the Planning Commissioners). The presentation included an overview

PLANNING COMMISSION MEETING
  1
MINUTES, MARCH 2, 2020
   of the housing laws that were introduced on January 1, 2020 and a side-by-side comparison of
  existing and changes to RHEMC Chapter 17.56.

  Director Wahba stated that staff recommends that the Planning Commission, 1) Open the public
  hearing; 2) Take public testimony; 3) Discuss the issues; 4) Close the public hearing; and 5) Adopt
  Resolution No. PA-200213-1, recommending to the City Council, adoption of an ordinance
  amending Chapter 17.56 (Accessory Dwelling Units) of the Rolling Hills Estates Municipal Code.

  In response to a question by COMMISSIONER SCOTT, Director Wahba stated that
  approximately 200 residences are not connected to sewer.

  COMMISSIONER SCOTT inquired about language in the ordinance to waive the 35’ setback for
  horse keeping areas due to an ADU. Director Wahba stated that the 35’ setback will not be
  enforced if it is due to an existing or proposed ADU and agreed with COMMISSIONER SCOTT
  that language to address this should be included in the ordinance. COMMISSIONER SCOTT
  suggested that following, “the existence of an ADU cannot prohibit horses on any lot”.

  Director Wahba stated that the city applied for an SB2 grant that will be used to develop a design
  manual for “by right” approvals for Accessory Dwelling Units.

  COMMISSIONER SCHACHTER inquired about 17.56.030 A3. Director Wahba stated that this
  addresses vacant lots or tear downs and rebuilds.

  In response to a question by COMMISSIONER SCHACHTER, Director Wahba stated that when
  the project must come before the Planning Commission for Neighborhood Compatibility, the city
  is maintaining full discretion.

  COMMISSIONER SCHACHTER pointed out an error in Exhibit A of the Resolution, Section
  17.56.060 G – Entrances. Director Wahba stated that this will be corrected. Correction as follows:

  G.  Entrances. An attached or internal ADU must have a separate entrance to the
  ADU, which must be located on the side or at the rear of the primary dwelling unit
  and may also be served by a common entrance with the primary dwelling unit. or
  No ADU will be required to provide a new passageway from the ADU to the street.

  COMMISSIONER SCHACHTER asked about the access for walking distance to public transit.
  Attorney Burrows stated that the means of access to public transit is not defined.

  COMMISSIONER SCHACHTER inquired about the letter received from The Californians for
  Home Ownership addressing their concerns regarding the annual report and the fourth
  amendment. Attorney Burrows stated that a suggestion to city council can be made to include
  language that allows certification of an owner occupied unit rather asking for a list of names.

  CHAIR CARMAN requested clarification on Exhibit A of the resolution, section 17.56.060 (I).
  Director Wahba stated that if access is only available by way of exterior stairs located in the front
  of the property, the city cannot prohibit this.

  CHAIR CARMAN inquired about ADU’s proposed at the bottom of a canyon. Director Wahba
  stated that staff spoke to the Fire Department and the property owner may need to pass a fire
  flow test from a nearby fire hydrant, install sprinklers, or provide access for emergency vehicles.

  CHAIR CARMAN opened the public hearing.

  COMMISSIONER SCOTT made a motion, seconded by COMMISSIONER MEDAWAR to,

  CLOSE THE PUBLIC HEARING.

  Ayes: Medawar, Yoo, Schachter, Scott, Edler, Carman
  Noes:
  Absent: Zigrang
  Abstain:

  Director Wahba stated that staff will work with the City Attorney’s Office to include language in
  the ordinance to address waiving the 35’ setback for neighboring property owners to an existing
  ADU, who would like to have horses on their property.

PLANNING COMMISSION MEETING
  2
MINUTES, MARCH 2, 2020
   COMMISSIONER SCHACHTER made a motion, seconded by COMMISSIONER MEDAWAR to,

  ADOPT RESOLUTION NO. PA-200213-1, SUBJECT TO THE RECOMMENDATIONS
  DISCUSSED BY THE PLANNING COMMISSION.

  Ayes: Medawar, Yoo, Schachter, Scott, Edler, Carman
  Noes:
  Absent: Zigrang
  Abstain:

  Director Wahba stated that this item will be presented to the City Council on Tuesday, March 24,
  2020.

  Item 10A taken out of order

  10.  DIRECTOR ITEMS

  A.  SOUTH BAY CITIES COUNCIL OF GOVERNMENTS – 21ST ANNUAL GENERAL
  ASSEMBLY, MARCH 19, 2020.

  Director Wahba encouraged the Planning Commission to attend the SBCCOG 21st Annual
  General Assembly, which will be held on March 19, 2020.

  Item 11A taken out of order

  11.  MATTERS OF INFORMATION

  A.  ADJOURNED CITY COUNCIL AND PLANNING COMMISSION JOINT MEETING
  MINUTES, FEBRUARY 11, 2020

  B.  CITY COUNCIL ACTIONS, FEBRUARY 11, 2020

  C.  CITY COUNCIL ACTIONS, FEBRUARY 25, 2020

  COMMISSIONER SCOTT moved to,

  RECEIVE AND FILE ITEMS 11A THROUGH 11C

  There being no objection, CHAIR CARMAN so ordered.

  9.  COMMISSION ITEMS

  In response to a request by COMMISSIONER MEDAWAR, Director Wahba provided an update
  on the CalWater project and stated that the construction on Crenshaw Blvd. at Silver Spur Road
  should be completed by Friday. The traffic signal at the intersection of Crenshaw Blvd. and Silver
  Spur Rd. should be back to normal.

  In response to a question by COMMISSIONER YOO, Director Wahba that the Cal Water project
  should be completed by this summer.

  14.  ADJOURNMENT

  CHAIR CARMAN adjourned the meeting at 7:46 p.m.

  Next Meeting: Monday, April 6, 2020 at 7:00 pm in the Council Chamber of Rolling Hills Estates
  City Hall, 4045 Palos Verdes Drive north, Rolling Hills Estate, California.

  Respectfully submitted,  Approved,
